label: Google Analytics 4
description: Send purchases, refunds and sign-ups to Google Analytics 4 from the server with the Measurement Protocol, so they are recorded even when ad blockers or closed tabs stop browser tracking

actions.label: Validate setup
actions.hint: Checks the Measurement ID and a sample purchase with the GA4 validation server

fields.label: Measurement ID
fields.description: GA4 → Admin → Data streams → your web stream

fields.label: Measurement Protocol API secret
fields.description: GA4 → Admin → Data streams → your web stream → Measurement Protocol API secrets → Create

fields.label: Enable Integration
fields.description: Send events to GA4 as orders and accounts change

fields.label: Send refunds
fields.description: Send a refund event with the refunded amount when an order is refunded, fully or partly

fields.label: Refund canceled orders
fields.description: Report the rest of the order value as refunded when an order is canceled

fields.label: Send sign-ups
fields.description: Send a sign_up event when a customer account is created

fields.label: Send user ID
fields.description: Send the Swell customer ID as user_id so GA4 can join a customer's devices

fields.label: Debug mode
fields.description: Show events in GA4 Admin → DebugView. Turn off when you are done testing.
